Staging release 8 (test build)

Test build that records which device unlocked or locked your vault in its history.

Status

Status
Deprecated (move-only)
Published

Not set

Replaced by a newer release. It still unlocks and lets you move to the newer release, nothing more.

Changes

  • Your vault's history records which device unlocked or locked it (VAULT-MESSAGING 0.23.2).
  • The build's base images come from the AWS ECR Public mirror at the same pinned digests; nothing else in the vault changes.
  • Built from vettid-vault commit 6a752d2 (tag release/staging/8) and independently rebuilt on 2026-10-10 with a matching PCR0.

Security

No security fix

git clone https://github.com/vettid/vettid-vault && cd vettid-vault
git checkout release/staging/8
gh release download release/staging/8 -p measurements.json -p vault-enclave.eif -D published
CHANNEL=staging release/rebuild.sh out published/measurements.json
